thread:
maria (partnerships): Hey team — we need a clear, short SEV handoff ladder for the new Marketplace SI integrations. Partner asked for a single-page oncall flow they can follow when they hit a 503 or data-mismatch SEV. Can we finalize?

alex (partner-success): Thanks for flagging. They want: who to message first, what info to include, and who opens the joint war room. Prefer minimal noise.

tim (eng-sre): Draft proposal: 1) Partner oncall posts to #partner-marketplace-<partner> and pings @redwood-partner-oncall. 2) If no ack in 10m or SEV1, partner escalates to @redwood-sre-oncall + opens war room. 3) If cross-org impact, escalate to @eng-incident-comm and assign liaison.

jules (solutions): That matches our usual but add: include tenant id, request-id, timestamp, model name, and sample prompt. Also add a link to the fallback model/version to switch to.

maria (partnerships): Nice. Can we put that into a tiny runnable checklist and a snippet they can paste into Slack? Partner likes copy/paste.

ananya (cs): I'll own the checklist copy. Also propose we create a shared private channel: #partner-<partner>-sev (invited: partner, partner-success, solutions, eng-sre, oncall). That way the partner doesn't have to DM multiple people.

ops-bot: Reminder: create private channel requires partner legal approval. See https://redwood.example/legal/partner-channels

alex (partner-success): Noted — partner legal approved the channel for PII-free incidents.

maria (partnerships): Ok let's finalize wording. Tim — can you paste the small YAML/ladder we can attach to the marketplace listing and the internal runbook link?

tim (eng-sre): Here you go (copy/paste friendly):

```yaml
escalation_ladder:
  - step: "Partner oncall posts to #partner-<partner>-sev and pings @redwood-partner-oncall"
    wait: "10m ack or triage"
  - step: "If SEV1 or no ack -> ping @redwood-sre-oncall and open war room (zoom/bridge)"
    actions:
      - "Collect tenant_id, request_id, model, prompt, logs link"
  - step: "If cross-customer impact -> notify @eng-incident-comm and assign incident lead"
  - step: "If policy/compliance scope -> invite security and legal"
  - step: "Postmortem: partner + redwood + SI reps within 5 business days"
```

jules (solutions): Perfect. Add a short paste for the partner to send as the initial post: "SEV1: 503 errors for tenant <tenant_id>. Request samples: <request-id>. Affected model: <model>. Please ack and join #partner-<partner>-sev."

ananya (cs): I'll turn this into a 1-page PDF and add to the marketplace onboarding packet. Also scheduling a 30m walkthrough with the partner's oncall next Tue.

maria (partnerships): Two quick ops items: 1) Create the private channel once legal confirms (ops-bot link above). 2) Add a short webhook that auto-posts error summaries from partner logs into the channel (ops infra can help).

tim (eng-sre): I'll add a TODO in the internal runbook and create the webhook template. Runbook link: https://runbooks.redwood.example/partner-sev-ladder

alex (partner-success): I'll send the paste and PDF to partner after the walkthrough.

maria (partnerships): Great. Last ask — can we agree on SLAs for first ack: 10m for SEV1 during oncall hours, 30m for SEV2. Add to the doc?

tim (eng-sre): Yes. Adding SLA lines.

maria (partnerships): Thanks all. If no objections, I'll push the doc to the marketplace listing and notify the partner after the walkthrough. :thumbsup:
